byId.bw5wYLxeb_vb4FeIzT_: Former math teacher with 9 years turning "I hate math" into "That's it?"
byId.bw5wYLxeb_YfmS2tChU: Nine years as a school math teacher, five at BrightPath. Maya's specialty is the learner who has decided they're "just not a math person" she disagrees, and she's usually right within a month. Her sessions run on questions, not lectures: learners do the talking, she does the steering.

props.title: Find the gap
props.info: The first ten minutes are diagnostic. Maya works backwards from the question that caused the trouble until she finds the step where the confusion actually started — usually two topics earlier than anyone expected.

props.title: Rebuild the floor
props.info: Once the gap is named, it gets rebuilt properly rather than patched. Short, repeated practice on the underlying idea until it is automatic, so the harder work has something solid to stand on.

props.title: Make them prove it
props.info: Every session ends with the learner explaining the method back, unaided. If they can teach it, they own it — and that is the point where "I'm not a math person" quietly stops being true.

props._01Question: My child is behind how fast can they catch up?
props._01Answer: Most learners close a level gap in one to two terms with two sessions a week. Our free assessment gives you an honest estimate before you commit.
props._02Question: Do you follow the school curriculum?
props._02Answer: Yes. We follow your child’s school curriculum while filling the gaps that make new topics harder to follow. Our sessions build understanding before moving ahead.
props._03Question: What about exam and test prep?
props._03Answer: Yes. We focus on key topics, practice questions, and exam strategies that help your child prepare with confidence. Our sessions target the skills they need most.
props._04Question: Can we switch between private and group?
props._04Answer: Yes. You can switch between private and group sessions as your child’s needs change. We’ll help you choose the format that gives them the right support.

byId.bw5wYLxeb_vb4FeIzT_: Chemistry grad who explains concepts with fun kitchen experiments.
byId.bw5wYLxeb_YfmS2tChU: David Okafor turns complicated science topics into clear, memorable ideas through questions, experiments, and conversations that keep learners curious and involved.

props.title: Open with a question
props.info: David starts with something a learner cannot immediately answer — why does the ice melt faster in water than in air? Curiosity does the heavy lifting before any terminology appears.

props.title: Make it physical
props.info: The idea gets demonstrated, usually with something from a kitchen cupboard. Watching a reaction happen fixes it in memory far better than reading the definition of one.

props.title: Put it in their words
props.info: The learner writes the explanation themselves, in plain language. David corrects the science, never the phrasing — the goal is understanding that survives past the exam.

props._01Question: My child finds science difficult. Can they catch up?
props._01Answer: Yes! We start by identifying exactly where the gap is — whether it's concepts, formulas, or lab work — and build from there. Most students see noticeable improvement within a few sessions.
props._02Question: Do you follow the school curriculum?
props._02Answer: Yes, we align with your child's school syllabus so every session directly supports what they're learning in class. We also go beyond the textbook to build real understanding.
props._03Question: Do you cover experiments and practical work?
props._03Answer: Absolutely. We include hands-on experiments, virtual labs, and practical demonstrations to make science tangible — not just theory on paper.
props._04Question: What about exam and test prep?
props._04Answer: Yes, We cover past papers, marking schemes, and exam technique so students feel confident and prepared, not just knowledgeable.
props._05Question: Can we switch between private and group?
props._05Answer: Yes, you can switch anytime based on what works best for your child at that moment. No lock-in, full flexibility.

byId.bw5wYLxeb_vb4FeIzT_: Essay whisperer. Gets reluctant readers hooked one short story at a time.
byId.bw5wYLxeb_YfmS2tChU: Sarah Whitmore makes English feel practical and approachable, helping learners express ideas clearly while building stronger reading, writing, and communication skills.

props.title: Start with something worth reading
props.info: Sarah picks a short text the learner actually wants to finish. Reluctant readers are rarely lazy; they have usually just been handed the wrong book.

props.title: Take the writing apart
props.info: Together they work out why a paragraph lands — the order of the ideas, the length of the sentences, the word doing the real work. Structure becomes visible instead of mysterious.

props.title: Rewrite one paragraph properly
props.info: Rather than a whole essay done adequately, one paragraph gets redrafted until it is genuinely good. That standard then carries into everything else they write.

props._01Question: My child is behind in English. Can they catch up?
props._01Answer: Yes, with guided lessons and steady practice children can close gaps and build confidence in reading, writing, and speaking.
props._02Question: Do you follow the school curriculum?
props._02Answer: Yes, lessons are aligned with school standards ensuring progress supports classroom learning and exam requirements.
props._03Question: Can you help with reading and writing?
props._03Answer: Yes, we focus on phonics, comprehension, grammar, and structured writing to strengthen both fluency and accuracy.
props._04Question: What about exam and test prep?
props._04Answer: Yes, tailored practice sessions, mock tests, and feedback help students prepare effectively for school exams and assessments.
props._05Question: Can we switch between private and group?
props._05Answer: Yes, families can choose flexible options moving between one‑to‑one sessions and group classes as needs change.

byId.bw5wYLxeb_vb4FeIzT_: Builds games with students from day one the syntax sneaks in on its own.
byId.bw5wYLxeb_YfmS2tChU: Alex Rivera helps young learners move from following tutorials to building real projects, developing both technical confidence and practical problem-solving skills.

props.title: Pick something worth building
props.info: The session opens with what the learner wants to make, not the topic that comes next in a syllabus. A game they care about will carry them through concepts a worksheet never could.

props.title: Break it into small wins
props.info: Alex splits the build into pieces that each work on their own. Something runs on screen within the first session — progress you can see beats progress you are told about.

props.title: Ship it, then break it
props.info: Working code gets deliberately broken so the learner can debug it. Reading an error message without panicking is the skill that separates following tutorials from actually building things.

props._01Question: My child has never coded before. Can they start?
props._01Answer: Absolutely! We start from zero, no experience needed. We begin with Scratch and move to real languages at their own pace.
props._02Question: Do you teach real programming languages?
props._02Answer: Yes! We teach Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and more. Students move from block-based coding to real code naturally, so it never feels overwhelming.
props._03Question: Can they build their own website or game?
props._03Answer: Yes, that's one of the best parts! Students work on real projects like games, apps, and websites. Building something they're proud of keeps them motivated and learning faster.
props._04Question: What about school or exam preparation?
props._04Answer: We cover school computer science curriculum, coding theory, and practical exam skills. Whether it's GCSE, IGCSE, or any board exam, we've got it covered.
props._05Question: Can we switch between private and group?
props._05Answer: Yes, anytime! Switch between private 1-on-1 sessions and group classes based on what suits your child best. No commitment, full flexibility.

Introduction

Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains how BrightPath collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our website, learning services, and mentoring sessions.

By using BrightPath, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

Information we collect

We may collect information that helps us provide a better learning experience, including:

  • Name and contact details

  • Email address and phone number

  • Learner age and education level

  • Learning goals and subject preferences

  • Session attendance and scheduling information

  • Learning progress and mentor notes

  • Messages and information submitted through forms

  • Payment and billing information

  • Device, browser, and website usage information

How we use your information

We use your information to:

  • Create and manage learner accounts

  • Plan and personalise learning sessions

  • Match learners with suitable mentors

  • Track learning progress and provide feedback

  • Schedule and manage sessions

  • Process payments and manage subscriptions

  • Respond to questions and support requests

  • Send important service and account updates

  • Improve our learning experience and website

  • Protect BrightPath against fraud, misuse, and security threats

Learning information

We may use information about a learner’s level, goals, progress, attendance, and session feedback to help mentors prepare effective and personalised learning experiences. This information is used only for providing and improving our educational services.

Cookies

BrightPath uses cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, understand website activity, and improve website performance. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings, although some features may not work as intended.

Payment information

If you pay online, payment details are processed securely by our payment provider. BrightPath does not see or store your full card number or payment credentials.

Data security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, loss, misuse, or disclosure. However, no online service or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Third-party services

We may work with trusted third-party providers for services such as payment processing, scheduling, communications, analytics, hosting, and website functionality. These providers only receive the information needed to provide their services and are expected to handle it appropriately.

Sharing your information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share relevant information with mentors, service providers, or other trusted partners when necessary to provide BrightPath services, operate our platform, or meet legal requirements.

Your rights

Depending on applicable law, you may request to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you

  • Correct inaccurate or outdated information

  • Request deletion of your personal information

  • Withdraw consent where applicable

  • Opt out of marketing communications

  • Ask questions about how your information is used

Children's information

BrightPath may provide learning services to children and young learners. Where appropriate, we rely on a parent or guardian to provide information and manage the learner's account. We take reasonable steps to protect learner information and use it only for providing our educational services.

Data retention

We keep personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain appropriate records, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and protect our legitimate interests. When information is no longer needed, we take reasonable steps to delete or securely dispose of it.

Policy updates

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our services, technology, or legal requirements. Any changes will become effective when the updated policy is published on our website.

Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, how we handle your information, or your privacy rights, please contact the BrightPath team.

Acceptance of terms

By using BrightPath, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with them, please discontinue using our website and services.

Using BrightPath

BrightPath provides personalised learning sessions, educational resources, and mentoring support for learners. Users agree to provide accurate information and use our services responsibly.

Learner accounts

Parents, guardians, or learners are responsible for keeping account information accurate and login details secure. Please let us know if you believe your account has been accessed without permission.

Learning sessions

Sessions are intended for the learner registered with BrightPath and should not be shared with another person. Session times, formats, and mentor assignments may vary based on the learner’s needs and availability.

Payments

All payments must be completed through the payment methods provided by BrightPath. Prices and available plans may change from time to time. Any applicable payment, cancellation, or refund terms will be communicated before purchase.

Our content

Learning materials, lesson plans, videos, text, graphics, worksheets, branding, and other BrightPath content belong to BrightPath or our content partners. They may not be copied, reproduced, shared, or redistributed without permission.

User conduct

When using BrightPath, users agree not to:

  • Share or distribute BrightPath learning materials without permission

  • Upload harmful, misleading, or inappropriate content

  • Attempt to access accounts, systems, or information without authorisation

  • Interfere with or disrupt our website or learning services

  • Use BrightPath in a way that violates applicable laws

Mentor and learner interactions
